'''Yuula''' was a part of the [[Umbaran commando]]'s [[crystal guard]]<ref name="Scars" /> in [[3629 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref> She had to go on hiatus because she was injured by a [[Vixian Mauler]] while working for [[Squad One (Umbaran)|Squad One]]. Because of that, Squad One recruited a [[Unidentified Umbaran commando|rookie]] to take her place for a [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Scars" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yuula was first mentioned in<ref name="Scars" /> the short story "[[Trading Scars]]" written by [[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|StillNotSam|status/898274643756421120|[[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]|quote=So, um... I'm really self-conscious about my prose and it took a lot of guts for me to write this little short story, so I'm proud I did it!|archivedate=20200814154941}}</ref> and published in the developer blog for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 17]], [[2017]].<ref name="Scars" />
